mission_09: Hybrid reasoning systems combine neural perception (learning to extract symbolic concepts from raw data) with symbolic reasoning (applying logical rules to derive conclusions). The neural module maps high-dimensional inputs to interpretable symbol probabilities, while the symbolic module applies domain knowledge rules to refine these probabilities. This two-stage architecture separates learning (perception) from reasoning (inference), making the system both adaptive and interpretable. In this mission, you implement a perception module that maps raw features to symbol probabilities via a neural network, a reasoning module that applies rules to derive new symbol probabilities, a combined forward pipeline, perception training with binary cross-entropy, and an explanation system that traces the full reasoning chain from raw input through perception to symbolic inference.
